title: Right-Angle Drop Drain with Slotted Covers
description: One original empty static architectural drainage-channel visual module. A single continuous grounded L-shaped stone body joins two perpendicular open U-section mouths through one genuinely connected right-angle channel. The incoming floor is higher than the outgoing floor, with one full-width finite vertical drop face at the turn. Complete thick floors, continuous outer and inner corner walls, all terminal cut faces and the full L-shaped ground sole belong to one closed material surface. Two separate thick rectangular bridge covers each cross a different arm, each has one genuine full-thickness elongated slot, and both complete side-bearing patches of each cover sit on the channel banks. Three closed connected editable meshes and three constant opaque untextured PBR materials. Metres, native Z up, incoming mouth -Y, outgoing mouth +X, horizontal bounds-centred ground origin. All specific shape coordinates newly authored; no existing culvert, Y-channel, quarter-turn cable tray, water-point drain, fish-table grate or other mesh is imported, rescaled, recoloured or extracted. One reusable architectural module and zero scenes; the covers are components, not additional assets. No water, pipes, pump, gate, debris, terrain, surrounding network, detachable-cover animation, text, logo or texture. Fixed stylized game-art geometry only: no real fluid flow, hydraulic efficiency, water retention, load-bearing crossing, pedestrian use, installation, fit with any previous module, civil engineering, drainage performance, manufacturer specification or safety certification. Dimensions describe game-space geometry only.
